items.title: Nvidia in Talks to Finance OpenAI, Report Says. What It Means for the Stock.
items.summary: The shares were up 0.5% to $207.86 in premarket trading, after falling 0.9% in the previous session.  Nvidia has missed out on the chip rally this year, up just 11% compared with the  (SOX) 67% rise — the index that tracks the 30 biggest U.S.-listed companies connected to semi’s. That’s started to change recently, though—the stock is up 3% in July, while the SOX is down 17%.  OpenAI and Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
